source_doc: course/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/05_5. Introduction to Optical Components.md
author_source: project/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/05_5. Introduction to Optical Components/src.py

points.K3: 玻璃和金属镜座热胀不一致
points.K15: 金属膜：宽带反射要防腐

points.K19: 中性密度滤光片：整体减光

shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学平台旁，台上摆着透镜、反射镜和彩色滤光片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an optical table with lenses, mirrors and colorful round filters on posts, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，认识光学元件。
overlay: 认识光学元件：材料、镀膜与滤光片

shots.scene: 材料、价格、镀膜、滤光片四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a glass block with a thermometer, a coin stack, a lens with a thin colored layer, and a round colored filter. No people.
shots.narration: 材料、价格、镀膜、滤光片，一个个看。

shots.scene: 老周递给阿杰一张空白采购单，桌上摆满各种镜片
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands the young male student a blank purchase list; the bench is covered with lenses, mirrors and colored filters.
shots.narration: 老周让阿杰给新光路挑元件。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着两片看似一样的镜片比较，一脸困惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student compares two lenses that look the same and frowns in confusion.
shots.narration: 长得差不多，价格却差了好几倍？

shots.scene: 小研笑着拿起一片镀膜反射镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and picks up a coated mirror that shimmers with color.
shots.narration: 小研说：材料、镀膜，都有门道。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 每片镜子、每片滤光片，都有讲究。

shots.scene: 欣欣从一本空白书本走向光学平台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot walks from a big open blank book toward an optical table with lenses and mirrors.
shots.narration: 前几课讲光的性质，这课走到实验台。

shots.scene: 透镜、棱镜、反射镜图标，旁边浮现温度计、锤子、试剂瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lens, a prism and a mirror, with a thermometer, a small hammer and a reagent bottle icon floating next to them. No people.
shots.narration: 元件除了光学性质，还有热、力、化学性质。

shots.scene: 可见光、紫外、红外三段彩带，各配一种材料块
shots.prompt_en: Three colored bands labeled only by color, violet, rainbow and dark red, each with a different transparent block below it. No people.
shots.narration: 不同波段，要选不同的材料。

shots.section_title: 怕热怕冷，也怕温度骤变
shots.scene: 一块玻璃窗口，一边是火焰图标，一边是雪花图标
shots.prompt_en: A clear glass optical window with a flame icon on the left and a snowflake icon on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 太热、太冷，玻璃都会发生变化。
overlay: 怕热怕冷，也怕温度骤变

shots.section_title: 怕热怕冷，也怕温度骤变
shots.scene: 温度计指针急速上下摆动，玻璃上出现波纹
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with a needle swinging quickly up and down beside a glass window showing wavy distortion lines. No people.
shots.narration: 温度骤变，影响更大。

shots.section_title: 怕热怕冷，也怕温度骤变
shots.scene: 两块玻璃，一块恢复原状打勾，一块留下永久变形
shots.prompt_en: Two glass windows side by side: one returns to flat shape with a green check, the other stays warped with an orange mark. No people.
shots.narration: 变化可能是暂时的，也可能是永久的。

shots.section_title: 怕热怕冷，也怕温度骤变
shots.scene: 小研在材料卡片间挑选，选中稳定的那块
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares several blank material cards on a desk and picks the one with a steady thermometer icon.
shots.narration: 选材，就选温度变化影响最小的。

shots.section_title: 玻璃和金属镜座热胀不一致
shots.scene: 一片透镜装在金属镜架的圆环里
shots.prompt_en: A glass lens held inside a round metal lens mount on a post, close-up. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃元件，常装在金属镜座里。
overlay: 玻璃和金属镜座热胀不一致

shots.section_title: 玻璃和金属镜座热胀不一致
shots.scene: 受热时金属环膨胀得快，玻璃膨胀得慢，箭头大小不同
shots.prompt_en: Cutaway icon of a metal ring and a glass disc being heated, the metal ring with big outward arrows and the glass with small arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 受热时，金属和玻璃胀得不一样多。

shots.section_title: 玻璃和金属镜座热胀不一致
shots.scene: 接合处出现红色应力线，玻璃边缘一道裂纹
shots.prompt_en: Close-up icon of the joint between a metal ring and glass with red stress lines and a small crack at the glass edge. No people.
shots.narration: 接合处就有应力，严重时元件会裂。

shots.section_title: 玻璃和金属镜座热胀不一致
shots.scene: 透镜中心红、边缘蓝的温度图，光线穿过后弯曲
shots.prompt_en: A lens icon with a heat map, red in the center and blue at the edges, and light rays bending unevenly after passing through. No people.
shots.narration: 热从边缘散走，中心热、边缘冷。

shots.section_title: 玻璃和金属镜座热胀不一致
shots.scene: 光斑从清晰圆点变得模糊变形
shots.prompt_en: A sharp round light spot on a blank screen turning into a blurry distorted blob, shown as before and after. No people.
shots.narration: 这样，光学性能也会跟着变差。

shots.scene: 金属块像高速公路一样把热量快速导走，玻璃块像小路
shots.prompt_en: A metal block with wide fast heat arrows flowing through it like a highway, next to a glass block with a thin slow arrow like a narrow path. No people.
shots.narration: 金属像高速路，导热快；玻璃像小路。

shots.scene: 受热后金属块明显变长，玻璃块几乎不变
shots.prompt_en: Two bars being heated: a metal bar grows noticeably longer while a glass bar barely changes. No people.
shots.narration: 受热后，金属膨胀也比玻璃大得多。

shots.scene: 熔点和热膨胀两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a melting ice cube on a thermometer and a bar with outward arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 熔点和热膨胀，是选材的重要参数。

shots.scene: 一块窗口两侧压力箭头一大一小，窗口微微鼓起
shots.prompt_en: A round optical window with big pressure arrows on one side and small arrows on the other, bulging slightly. No people.
shots.narration: 受力不均，元件内部和表面会变形。

shots.scene: 一薄一厚两块窗口，口径相同，薄的弯曲
shots.prompt_en: Two round windows of the same diameter, one thin and bent under arrows, one thick and flat with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 口径越大、压差越大，窗口要越厚。

shots.scene: 材料极限的弹簧图标，拉到红线处
shots.prompt_en: A spring icon stretched up to a red limit line beside a glass window. No people.
shots.narration: 还要看材料能承受多大的力。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶滴下液滴，塑料镜片表面变毛糙
shots.prompt_en: A closed solvent bottle icon with one drop falling on a plastic lens, the lens surface turning cloudy and rough. No people.
shots.narration: 有的溶剂，会把塑料镜片腐蚀坏。

shots.scene: 盐晶窗口在水汽中像方糖一样慢慢溶化
shots.prompt_en: A clear salt crystal window slowly dissolving like a sugar cube in a cloud of water vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 盐晶窗口怕潮，遇水汽会溶掉。

shots.scene: 小研把盐晶窗口放进带干燥剂的密封盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves places a crystal window into a sealed box with desiccant packets.
shots.narration: 这类元件要防潮保存。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白清单查看试剂和元件是否相容
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank compatibility list with a reagent bottle icon and a lens icon side by side.
shots.narration: 用化学品前，先查它对元件的影响。

shots.scene: 老周把搭建光路的任务卡交给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands the young male student a blank task card in front of an empty optical table.
shots.narration: 搭光路、选元件，常是技术员的活。

shots.scene: 光学、热、化学、价格四个图标围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four icons arranged in a circle: a lens, a thermometer, a reagent bottle and a coin stack, with a check in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 光学、热、化学性质和价格，一起考虑。

shots.scene: 预算钱包和一篮子元件放在天平两端
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a wallet on one side and a basket of optical parts on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 预算有限，质量和价格要权衡。

shots.scene: 玻璃块经过研磨、抛光、检测三个工位
shots.prompt_en: A glass block moving through three stations shown as icons: grinding wheel, polishing pad and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃和石英要研磨、抛光、检测，较贵。

shots.scene: 模具一压就出一片塑料镜片
shots.prompt_en: A simple mold press icon popping out a plastic lens in one step. No people.
shots.narration: 塑料镜片能模压成型，便宜得多。

shots.scene: 大晶体在设备里慢慢长大，旁边是时钟和金币
shots.prompt_en: A large crystal slowly growing inside a machine, with a clock icon and a coin stack beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 晶体要用昂贵设备慢慢生长，也贵。

shots.scene: 镜片加上一层彩色膜，价格标签上升
shots.prompt_en: A lens receiving a thin colored coating layer while a blank price tag with an up arrow rises above it. No people.
shots.narration: 再镀一层膜，价格还要往上走。

shots.scene: 七个图标排成两行：尺寸、材料、曲率、精度、波长、镀膜、像差
shots.prompt_en: Seven icons in two rows: a ruler, a material block, a curved lens, a target, a rainbow wave, a coated layer and a blurry dot turning sharp. No people.
shots.narration: 尺寸、材料、曲率，都影响价格。

shots.scene: 平面片和曲面透镜对比，曲面加难度标记
shots.prompt_en: A flat glass plate next to a curved lens, the curved lens marked with extra stars for difficulty. No people.
shots.narration: 平面好做，曲面难做；精度越高越贵。

shots.scene: 彩虹波长带、镀膜层、清晰化的光斑三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a rainbow wavelength band, a coated layer and a blurry light spot turning sharp. No people.
shots.narration: 透什么波长、镀什么膜、校不校像差。

shots.scene: 小研在空白采购单上逐项打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks items on a blank purchase form at a desk next to a lens box.
shots.narration: 懂得这些，才能买得合适。

shots.scene: 反射镜、滤光片、透镜、棱镜整齐摆在托盘上
shots.prompt_en: A tray with a front surface mirror, round colored filters, lenses and a prism neatly arranged, close-up. No people.
shots.narration: 反射镜、滤光片、透镜、棱镜最常见。

shots.scene: 元件表面一层彩色薄膜被放大
shots.prompt_en: A magnified cross-section of a lens surface showing a very thin colored layer on top. No people.
shots.narration: 很多元件表面，都镀着一层薄膜。

shots.scene: 薄膜像一道阀门，调节光的透过和反射
shots.prompt_en: A thin film drawn as a small valve on a glass surface, controlling arrows of light that pass through or bounce back. No people.
shots.narration: 膜的厚度和成分，决定透多少、反多少。

shots.scene: 真空镀膜机外形，舱门紧闭
shots.prompt_en: A closed stainless steel vacuum coating chamber with a small round viewing window, in a clean room. No people.
shots.narration: 镀膜在真空镀膜机里完成。

shots.scene: 示意图：下方膜料化成蒸气，飘上去附着在镜片上
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram inside a dome: material at the bottom turns into vapor dots that rise and stick to lenses at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 一种是蒸发：把膜料变成蒸气，落到镜片上。

shots.scene: 示意图：彩色粒子撞击靶材，溅出的微粒落到冷却的镜片上
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: glowing particles strike a target plate, knocking off tiny bits that fly to a cooled lens. No people.
shots.narration: 一种是溅射：粒子撞靶，溅出微粒成膜。

shots.scene: 沙漏和停止按钮图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a stop button icon above a growing thin layer. No people.
shots.narration: 两种方法，都要边镀边控厚度。

shots.scene: 像秤一样的晶片，沾上膜料后指针变化
shots.prompt_en: A small quartz disc on a scale-like gauge, the needle moving as tiny dots land on it. No people.
shots.narration: 一种用石英晶片称重，膜越厚越重。

shots.scene: 晶片上层数越来越多，指针反应越来越迟钝
shots.prompt_en: The quartz disc covered with more and more layers, the gauge needle becoming sluggish with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 层数多了，这个办法就不太灵了。

shots.scene: 一束光穿过正在镀膜的镜片，旁边的亮度表随之变化
shots.prompt_en: A light beam passing through a lens being coated, with a brightness meter beside it changing level. No people.
shots.narration: 另一种看透射或反射光的变化来判断。

shots.scene: 两副眼镜对比：一副镜片反光刺眼，一副通透
shots.prompt_en: Two pairs of glasses side by side: one with strong glare reflections on the lenses, one clear without glare. No people.
shots.narration: 眼镜片反光少，靠的是增透膜。

shots.scene: 光照到膜上，上表面和下表面各反射一束
shots.prompt_en: A light ray hits a thin layer on glass; one reflection comes off the top surface and a second off the bottom surface. No people.
shots.narration: 膜的上下两面，各反射回一束光。

shots.scene: 两束反射波一高一低，叠加后变平
shots.prompt_en: Two wave lines, one crest aligned with the other's trough, merging into a flat line. No people.
shots.narration: 膜厚合适，两束反射光正好相互抵消。

shots.scene: 跷跷板两端一上一下、中间不动的比喻
shots.prompt_en: Two cartoon waves drawn as seesaw ends moving in opposite directions so the middle stays still. No people.
shots.narration: 就像一推一拉，力气刚好抵消。

shots.scene: 一层膜只对一种颜色最灵，多层膜覆盖更多颜色
shots.prompt_en: A single-layer coating icon matching one color of light, next to a multi-layer stack matching several colors. No people.
shots.narration: 单层只对一个波长最好，多层更有效。

shots.scene: 阳光照到镀膜窗户上，大部分被弹回去
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight hitting a coated building window, most of the light bouncing back outward, a cool room behind. No people.
shots.narration: 高反膜正相反，要把光尽量反回去。

shots.scene: 两束反射波峰对峰，叠加后更高
shots.prompt_en: Two wave lines with crests aligned, adding up into one taller wave. No people.
shots.narration: 两束反射光步调一致，相互加强。

shots.scene: 膜层一层层叠加，反射率条越来越满
shots.prompt_en: Coating layers stacking up one by one while a reflectance bar fills almost to the top. No people.
shots.narration: 层数越多，反射率越接近百分之百。

shots.scene: 激光管两端各有一面镜子，光在中间来回
shots.prompt_en: A simple laser tube icon with a mirror at each end and a light ray bouncing back and forth between them, enclosed. No people.
shots.narration: 激光器两端的反射镜，就靠多层高反膜。

shots.scene: 只有一种颜色、一个角度的光被反射，其他穿过
shots.prompt_en: A mirror reflecting only one color arriving at one angle, while other colors pass straight through. No people.
shots.narration: 它只对窄波段、特定角度有效。

shots.section_title: 金属膜：宽带反射要防腐
shots.scene: 金属镜面反射一整道彩虹光
shots.prompt_en: A shiny metal-coated mirror reflecting a whole rainbow of colors. No people.
shots.narration: 金属膜能在很宽的波段里高反射。
overlay: 金属膜：宽带反射要防腐

shots.section_title: 金属膜：宽带反射要防腐
shots.scene: 铝和金两面镜子，金镜在紫光处变暗
shots.prompt_en: Two mirrors, a silver-colored one reflecting all colors and a gold one reflecting red well but dim on violet. No people.
shots.narration: 铝膜各波段都不错，金膜擅长红外。

shots.section_title: 金属膜：宽带反射要防腐
shots.scene: 金属膜上出现锈斑，加一层透明保护层后锈斑消失
shots.prompt_en: A metal mirror surface with rust spots, then covered with a clear protective layer and the spots gone. No people.
shots.narration: 金属易腐蚀，要再镀一层保护膜。

shots.section_title: 金属膜：宽带反射要防腐
shots.scene: 戴手套的手只捏镜子边缘
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holding a coated mirror only by its edges over a clean cloth.
shots.narration: 所以镜面不要用手碰。

shots.scene: 八片不同颜色和灰度的滤光片排成扇形
shots.prompt_en: Eight round filters of different colors and grey shades arranged in a fan on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 滤光片按波长或强度，挡掉一部分光。

shots.scene: 滤光片分成几组的图示
shots.prompt_en: Filters sorted into labeled-by-icon groups: color, grey, single line, eye shape. No people.
shots.narration: 宽带、窄带、中性密度、偏振等，各有用途。

shots.scene: 一片蓝色滤光片，只放一段颜色通过
shots.prompt_en: A blue round filter letting a band of blue-green colors through while blocking red and violet. No people.
shots.narration: 宽带滤光片，放过一段波长。

shots.scene: 钟形曲线，半山腰处画一条横线
shots.prompt_en: A bell-shaped curve with a horizontal dashed line drawn halfway up and two marks where it crosses. No people.
shots.narration: 峰值一半高处的两端，就是通带宽度。

shots.section_title: 截止滤光片：挡掉有害波长
shots.scene: 一道门只让一侧颜色通过，另一侧被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A gate icon letting red light pass while blocking blue and violet light. No people.
shots.narration: 截止滤光片，一边放行，一边截断。
overlay: 截止滤光片：挡掉有害波长

shots.section_title: 截止滤光片：挡掉有害波长
shots.scene: 激光器输出绿光，还夹带看不见的红外光
shots.prompt_en: A closed laser box emitting a green beam with a faint dashed invisible beam drawn alongside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有的激光器出绿光，还带着看不见的红外。

shots.section_title: 截止滤光片：挡掉有害波长
shots.scene: 滤光片挡住虚线红外，只留绿光进入光路
shots.prompt_en: A filter in the beam path blocking the dashed invisible beam while the green beam continues into a beam dump. No people.
shots.narration: 用截止滤光片，把这段红外挡掉。

shots.section_title: 截止滤光片：挡掉有害波长
shots.scene: 欣欣点头，旁边是眼睛和仪器两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods next to two icons with green check marks: an eye and a measuring instrument.
shots.narration: 这样，就不会伤到眼睛和系统。

shots.section_title: 中性密度滤光片：整体减光
shots.scene: 灰色滤光片像墨镜一样让各种颜色同样变暗
shots.prompt_en: A grey round filter dimming all colors of a rainbow equally like sunglasses. No people.
shots.narration: 中性密度滤光片，各种颜色一起减光。
overlay: 中性密度滤光片：整体减光

shots.section_title: 中性密度滤光片：整体减光
shots.scene: 强光被灰片减弱后进入探测器，探测器安然无恙
shots.prompt_en: A strong light beam passing through a grey filter and entering a detector which shows a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 常用来保护怕强光的探测器。

shots.section_title: 中性密度滤光片：整体减光
shots.scene: 灰片一片比一片深，透过的光越来越少
shots.prompt_en: A row of grey filters getting darker one by one, with fewer light arrows coming out behind each. No people.
shots.narration: 光密度越大，透过的光越少。

shots.section_title: 中性密度滤光片：整体减光
shots.scene: 很亮的一束光，只剩一丝透过
shots.prompt_en: A bright beam hitting a dark grey filter with only a thin faint ray coming out. No people.
shots.narration: 光密度为二，只透过约百分之一。

shots.section_title: 窄带、辐射度与光度滤光片
shots.scene: 一根极窄的尖峰，只有一种颜色通过
shots.prompt_en: A single very narrow spike letting only one green color through a filter. No people.
shots.narration: 窄带滤光片，几乎只放一个波长。
overlay: 窄带、辐射度与光度滤光片

shots.section_title: 窄带、辐射度与光度滤光片
shots.scene: 探测器前加滤光片后，对各颜色反应一样高
shots.prompt_en: A detector with uneven bars for different colors, then with a filter in front the bars become equal height. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射度滤光片，让探测器对各色一视同仁。

shots.section_title: 窄带、辐射度与光度滤光片
shots.scene: 眼睛图标和绿色峰值曲线重合
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon next to a bell curve peaking at green, with a detector curve matching it. No people.
shots.narration: 光度滤光片，模仿人眼对颜色的感受。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴上一副标签空白的激光防护眼镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot puts on laser safety goggles with a blank label on the frame.
shots.narration: 激光防护眼镜，其实就是一种滤光片。

shots.scene: 眼睛剖面图，一束光被聚焦到眼底一个亮点
shots.prompt_en: A simple eye cross-section icon with a light beam focused to a tiny bright point at the back of the eye, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 眼睛会把光聚成一点，最容易受伤。

shots.scene: 眼底亮点变成伤疤图标，旁边是不可逆的箭头
shots.prompt_en: The bright spot at the back of the eye turns into a dark damage mark, with a one-way arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 伤到视网膜，可能无法恢复。

shots.scene: 眼镜挡住一种颜色的光，放过其他颜色
shots.prompt_en: Goggles blocking one color of light while letting other colors pass so the wearer can still see. No people.
shots.narration: 它挡住特定波长，放过其余的光。

shots.scene: 小研对照激光器和眼镜，确认波长一致
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares a closed laser box and goggles, each with a matching blank wavelength icon.
shots.narration: 所以，必须按激光的波长来选。

shots.scene: 一副眼镜挡住紫色和蓝色光，放过其余彩色光
shots.prompt_en: A pair of safety glasses stops violet and blue rays while the other colors of light pass through. No people.
shots.narration: 比如这副，挡紫外和蓝光，透可见光。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学平台前，元件一一亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of an optical table as lenses, mirrors and filters light up one by one.
shots.narration: 这课把光的知识，落到了元件上。

shots.scene: 一组镜架和立杆，带问号
shots.prompt_en: A set of empty lens mounts and posts on an optical table with a small question mark above. No people.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲怎样安装和固定元件。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现温度计、试剂瓶、金币图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a thermometer, a reagent bottle and a coin stack.
shots.narration: 选元件：看热、看化学、看价格。

shots.scene: 增透、高反、金属三种镀膜图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a glare-free lens, a mirror bouncing light back, and a shiny metal mirror with a clear protective layer. No people.
shots.narration: 增透抵消反射，高反加强反射。

shots.scene: 宽带、截止、中性密度滤光片图标
shots.prompt_en: Three filter icons: a colored band filter, a gate-like cutoff filter and a grey filter. No people.
shots.narration: 滤光片按波长或强度挡光。

shots.scene: 防护眼镜图标挡住一种颜色
shots.prompt_en: An icon of laser safety goggles blocking one color of light. No people.
shots.narration: 防护眼镜是滤光片，按波长选。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着防护眼镜在光学平台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing laser safety goggles waves goodbye beside a tidy optical table with the laser enclosure closed.
shots.narration: 下一课讲光学镜架，下次见！
